global.description: Global firewall behavior settings. Adjust log verbosity, naming conventions, and default security posture.

global.log_level.description: Verbosity of internal logging. Choose based on production needs (debug for troubleshooting, warn or info for production).

global.table_prefix.description: Prefix for nftables table and chain names (must be alphanumeric or underscore, starting with letter). Avoid collisions with other firewalls.

global.default_action.description: Default policy for traffic that doesn't match any rule. 'drop' is stealthy; 'reject' sends ICMP error back.

global.enable_conntrack.description: Enable kernel connection tracking for stateful filtering. Required for allowing return traffic automatically.

global.syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility used when logging firewall events. Must be a valid rsyslog/klog facility name.

items.description: A named zone grouping interfaces, with its own policies and security level.
Network interface name to bind to this zone (e.g., eth1, br-lan).

trust_level.description: Logical trust tier — used internally for policy generation and reporting.

enable_stateful.description: Allow return traffic for outbound connections initiated within this zone.

default_policy.description: Default policy for traffic entering this zone (before applying service rules).

new_conn_rate_limit.description: Maximum new connections per second per interface in this zone (0 = no limit). Helps mitigate SYN floods.

new_conn_rate_burst.description: Burst size for the new connection rate limit.

items.description: IP/CIDR or MAC addresses fully trusted in this zone (bypass rate limits and may affect policy enforcement).

zones.description: List of firewall zones. Each zone represents a network segment (e.g., LAN, DMZ, IoT) with its own interfaces and security settings.

items.description: Defines allowed unidirectional traffic flow from one zone to another.

src.description: Source zone name (must exist in zones list).

dst.description: Destination zone name (must exist in zones list).

enable_established.description: Automatically allow return traffic for connections initiated from src zone.

allowed_services.description: List of services/ports allowed from src zone to dst zone.

log_matches.description: Log each packet matching these rules (use sparingly to avoid log flooding).

zone_pairs.description: Bidirectional zone pairs define traffic flows between zones. Each pair is unidirectional; symmetric traffic requires two pairs.

items.description: Raw nft command blocks for advanced customization (e.g., custom chains, complex matching). Use with caution.

description.description: Brief explanation of what the block does.

body.description: Exact nft CLI command(s), e.g., 'add chain ip foomuuri custom { type filter hook input priority -5; }'
body.example: add chain ip foomuuri custom { type filter hook input priority -5; }\nadd rule ip foomuuri custom ip saddr 10.0.0.0/8 accept

raw_nft_commands.description: List of raw nft commands for expert customization — inserted verbatim into the generated nft ruleset.
